title: Modified Poisson regression for an adjusted risk ratio
summary: Estimates an adjusted risk ratio for a binary outcome using a log-link Poisson model with a robust variance (Zou 2004), instead of the odds ratio logistic regression would give.
pinned_defaults: R: vcovHC(type = 'HC0'). The package DEFAULT IS HC3, which is not Zou's method; omitting type silently reports a different standard error than the paper the file cites.
Python: fit(cov_type='HC0'). statsmodels defaults to the model-based covariance, which for a log-link Poisson fitted to binary data does not hold at all.
SAS: the REPEATED statement with subject=id is what produces the empirical variance; without it GENMOD reports model-based SEs.
Stata: vce(robust) applies a finite-sample correction and will NOT match HC0 exactly. Point estimate identical, SE different. Recorded in the file itself.
